disclaimer: Estimates for planning only. Not financial, tax or investment advice. Verify with your bank or a qualified professional.

categories.name: Home Loan
categories.description: Indian housing finance for purchase, plot, construction, renovation, top-up or balance transfer. Tenure 5–30 years; RBI LTV cap 75–90%.
checklistItems: Verify RBI 0% foreclosure fee rule on individual floating-rate home loans
Check EBLR repo-rate spread & quarterly reset clause in sanction letter
Collect original sale deed, NOC & mortgage release after final EMI
Confirm Section 24(b) & Section 80C eligibility (Old Tax Regime)

variants.name: Floating — Repo / EBLR Linked
variants.howItWorks: Linked directly to RBI Policy Repo Rate plus bank spread. Resets at least once every 3 months under RBI guidelines; 0% prepayment penalty for individuals.
variants.bestFor: Most Indian homebuyers wanting fast transmission of RBI repo rate cuts.

variants.name: Fixed Rate
variants.howItWorks: Interest rate and monthly EMI stay locked for the full tenure. Prepayment or foreclosure charges typically apply.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers who want complete monthly EMI certainty regardless of RBI repo moves.

variants.name: MCLR-Linked (Legacy)
variants.howItWorks: Linked to the bank's Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate with a 6-month or 12-month reset cycle.
variants.bestFor: Existing pre-2019 borrowers comparing legacy MCLR loans against EBLR balance transfer.

variants.name: Hybrid (Fixed then Floating)
variants.howItWorks: Fixed interest rate for the initial 2–5 years, then automatically converts to repo-linked floating rate.
variants.bestFor: Buyers seeking predictable early EMIs while expecting long-term rates to soften.

variants.name: Standard Level EMI
variants.howItWorks: Equal monthly instalments across the tenure; interest share falls while principal share grows each month.
variants.bestFor: Salaried borrowers with steady monthly cash flows.

variants.name: Step-Up EMI
variants.howItWorks: Starts with a lower EMI and increases annually by a fixed percentage as income grows.
variants.bestFor: Early-career professionals expecting regular annual increments.

variants.name: Step-Down EMI
variants.howItWorks: Higher initial EMIs that step down periodically, slashing total interest paid.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers nearing retirement or expecting lower future income.

variants.name: Home Loan Overdraft / Offset (MaxGain)
variants.howItWorks: Surplus cash parked in a linked overdraft account reduces the interest-bearing principal while remaining withdrawable.
variants.bestFor: Self-employed or high-liquidity savers wanting instant access to emergency cash plus interest savings.

variants.name: Full Disbursement
variants.howItWorks: Entire sanctioned loan amount is disbursed upfront for ready-to-move properties.
variants.bestFor: Ready-to-move apartments or resale properties.

variants.name: Tranche + Pre-EMI (Under Construction)
variants.howItWorks: Disbursed in construction-linked stages; you pay Pre-EMI (interest-only on drawn amount) until handover, then full EMI.
variants.bestFor: Under-construction builder flats or self-construction homes.

variants.name: Home Purchase
variants.howItWorks: Standard residential purchase loan for ready or under-construction housing.
variants.bestFor: Buying an apartment, row house, or villa.

variants.name: Plot Purchase
variants.howItWorks: Financing residential land plots within municipal or development authority limits; typically lower LTV and shorter tenure.
variants.bestFor: Buying a residential plot to build later.

variants.name: Self Construction
variants.howItWorks: Stage-wise financing to build a house on an already-owned residential plot.
variants.bestFor: Plot owners constructing a custom home.

variants.name: Extension / Renovation
variants.howItWorks: Funds structural repairs, additional floors, or home improvement against existing residential property.
variants.bestFor: Upgrading or expanding an owned house.

variants.name: Balance Transfer
variants.howItWorks: Transfers remaining outstanding principal to a lower-rate lender and calculates net savings after switching costs.
variants.bestFor: Existing borrowers stuck on higher legacy MCLR or wider spreads.

variants.name: Top-Up Loan
variants.howItWorks: Additional loan over an active home loan; models blended monthly EMI across existing + top-up accounts.
variants.bestFor: Existing home loan borrowers needing extra funds cheaper than a personal loan.

categories.name: Personal Loan
categories.description: Unsecured Indian consumer credit for emergencies, travel, wedding, or debt consolidation. Compare quoted flat vs true reducing APR.
checklistItems: Always check KFS (Key Fact Statement) APR — not just a quoted flat rate
Check lock-in period (often 6–12 EMIs) and foreclosure fee + 18% GST
Verify whether optional credit-shield insurance is bundled into principal

variants.name: Standard Term Loan
variants.howItWorks: Fixed lump sum credited upfront and repaid through fixed reducing-balance monthly EMIs.
variants.bestFor: Planned one-time expenses like medical bills, wedding, or debt consolidation.

variants.name: Flexi / Personal Overdraft
variants.howItWorks: Approved credit line where you withdraw as needed and pay interest only on the utilized daily/monthly balance.
variants.bestFor: Irregular cash needs where funds can be repaid quickly.

variants.name: Pre-Approved Instant Loan
variants.howItWorks: Instant disbursement for existing salary/bank account holders with minimal documentation.
variants.bestFor: Urgent short-term liquidity with fast disbursal.

variants.name: Reducing Balance (True APR)
variants.howItWorks: Interest is charged strictly on remaining principal each month; also displays flat-rate equivalent.
variants.bestFor: Standard transparent Indian bank loans (RBI KFS compliant).

variants.name: Flat Rate Quote (with Effective EAR)
variants.howItWorks: Charges interest on the original full principal throughout tenure; engine reveals the true Effective Annual Rate (IRR).
variants.bestFor: Auditing dealer or NBFC flat-rate quotes before signing.

categories.name: Vehicle Loan
categories.description: Financing for New Cars, Two-Wheelers, Electric Vehicles (EV), and Used Cars with balloon option and RC hypothecation checklist.
checklistItems: Collect Bank Loan Closure Letter & Hypothecation NOC (valid 90 days)
Obtain 2 signed copies of RTO Form 35 from the lender
Submit Hypothecation Termination on Parivahan portal & update Smart Card RC
Notify motor insurer to remove bank hypothecation endorsement on policy

variants.name: New Car
variants.howItWorks: Standard secured auto loan against ex-showroom or on-road vehicle value up to 90% LTV.
variants.bestFor: Buying a new hatchback, sedan, or SUV.

variants.name: Electric Vehicle (EV Green)
variants.howItWorks: Concessional green auto loan rate with lower processing fees offered by Indian PSU & private banks.
variants.bestFor: Electric cars and electric scooters.

variants.name: Two-Wheeler
variants.howItWorks: Short-tenure motorcycle or scooter loan; compare against flat-rate dealer quotes carefully.
variants.bestFor: Commuter bikes, scooters, and superbikes.

variants.name: Used / Pre-Owned Car
variants.howItWorks: Higher interest rate and lower valuation-based LTV (typically up to 75–80%) for pre-owned vehicles.
variants.bestFor: Certified pre-owned vehicles up to 8 years old.

variants.name: Standard Level EMI
variants.howItWorks: Equal monthly instalments fully amortizing the vehicle loan to zero.
variants.bestFor: Buyers planning to keep the vehicle through full ownership.

variants.name: Balloon Payment
variants.howItWorks: Lower monthly EMIs during the tenure with a lump-sum balloon (20–35% of principal) due in the final month.
variants.bestFor: Buyers expecting a bonus or planning to upgrade/sell before the final year.

variants.name: Step-Up EMI
variants.howItWorks: Lower early EMIs stepping up each year.
variants.bestFor: First-time car buyers expecting rising salary.

categories.name: Education Loan
categories.description: Study in India or Abroad with semester-wise disbursement, course + 6–12m moratorium (simple vs compound), and Section 80E tax benefit.
checklistItems: Paying simple interest during moratorium prevents compounding & can earn 0.5–1% bank concession
Section 80E allows 100% interest deduction for up to 8 assessment years (Old Regime)
Check CSIS / Padho Pardesh / Vidya Lakshmi subsidy eligibility

variants.name: India — Unsecured (Up to ₹7.5L / Premier)
variants.howItWorks: IBA Model Education Loan for Indian universities/IITs/IIMs without collateral.
variants.bestFor: Domestic UG/PG degrees at accredited Indian institutions.

variants.name: Abroad — Secured (Collateral)
variants.howItWorks: Higher limits for overseas universities backed by property/FD collateral at lower interest rates.
variants.bestFor: MS/MBA/UG degrees abroad with family collateral.

variants.name: Abroad — Unsecured (NBFC / Private)
variants.howItWorks: Collateral-free overseas study loan evaluated on university rank and co-applicant income.
variants.bestFor: Overseas admits without pledgeable property.

variants.name: Simple Interest Moratorium (Course + 6–12m)
variants.howItWorks: Principal is paused during course + grace period; simple interest accrues without compounding on unpaid interest.
variants.bestFor: PSU bank IBA schemes where moratorium interest is simple.

variants.name: Compound / Capitalized Moratorium
variants.howItWorks: Unpaid monthly moratorium interest is added to principal each month, increasing the post-moratorium EMI.
variants.bestFor: Comparing the true cost of deferring interest vs servicing it during study.

variants.name: Semester-Wise Disbursement
variants.howItWorks: Tuition tranches are disbursed each semester; interest accrues only on disbursed tranches.
variants.bestFor: Multi-year degree programs billed per semester.

categories.name: Gold Loan
categories.description: Quick collateralized loan against 18K–22K gold jewellery. RBI LTV cap (75%) and auction-risk alert driven by data.
checklistItems: Monitor LTV closely: if gold price dips or unpaid bullet interest pushes LTV past the RBI cap, lender can issue an auction notice
Only 18K–22K jewellery/bank coins up to 50g are accepted; stones are excluded from net weight
Verify purity appraisal receipt and sealed packet weight before signing

variants.name: Monthly EMI
variants.howItWorks: Standard reducing-balance EMI paying both principal and interest every month.
variants.bestFor: Salaried borrowers wanting disciplined closure with zero bullet risk.

variants.name: Monthly Interest-Only
variants.howItWorks: Pay only monthly interest during the tenure and repay full principal at maturity.
variants.bestFor: Short-term working capital or bridging cash flows.

variants.name: Bullet Repayment (Maturity)
variants.howItWorks: Zero monthly payments; full principal plus accrued interest is settled in one lump sum at maturity (watch LTV drift).
variants.bestFor: Very short-term liquidity (3–12 months) when lump-sum inflow is certain.

categories.name: Loan Against Property
categories.description: High-ticket mortgage loan against residential or commercial property (up to 65% LTV, up to 15 years) for business or personal needs.
checklistItems: Note: Individual floating LAP for non-business purpose qualifies for 0% foreclosure fee; business-purpose LAP may carry a fee
Factor in legal, technical valuation, and MODT stamp duty charges
Compare LAP rate vs Home Loan Top-Up before pledging property

variants.name: Term Loan Against Property
variants.howItWorks: Floating or fixed amortizing mortgage loan against self-occupied residential or commercial property.
variants.bestFor: Long-term capital needs at lower rates than unsecured loans.

variants.name: Dropline Overdraft (OD)
variants.howItWorks: Overdraft credit limit backed by property where you pay interest only on utilized funds.
variants.bestFor: Business owners managing seasonal inventory or receivables.

variants.name: LAP Balance Transfer
variants.howItWorks: Refinance an expensive NBFC LAP to a lower-rate bank mortgage.
variants.bestFor: Reducing EMI burden on existing property-backed loans.

categories.name: Loan Against Securities / FD / MF
categories.description: Overdraft or loan against Bank Fixed Deposits (FD + 1–2% spread) or pledged Equity Shares / Mutual Funds (50% RBI LTV cap + margin-call check).
checklistItems: Loan Against FD avoids premature FD break penalty and keeps earning FD interest
For Equity Shares / Equity MF, keep LTV below 40% to avoid sudden margin calls in market corrections
Debt Mutual Funds may offer higher LTV (70–80%) than Equity MF (50%)

variants.name: Loan Against Fixed Deposit (FD)
variants.howItWorks: Charged at FD Interest Rate + 1% to 2% spread (up to 90% of FD value) while your FD continues compounding.
variants.bestFor: Short-term cash needs without breaking an active bank FD.

variants.name: Loan Against Shares / Mutual Funds
variants.howItWorks: Pledge approved demat shares or MF units up to 50% RBI LTV; computes exact portfolio drop triggering a margin call.
variants.bestFor: Investors seeking liquidity without selling long-term equity holdings and triggering capital gains tax.

categories.name: Business / MSME Loan
categories.description: Indian MSME Term Loans, Working Capital / Cash Credit, Invoice Discounting, and PMMY Mudra tiers (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus).
checklistItems: PMMY Mudra caps (from schemes.json): Shishu up to ₹50K, Kishore ₹5L, Tarun ₹10L, Tarun Plus ₹20L
Check CGTMSE guarantee fee vs collateral-backed MSME term loan rate
Interest paid on business loans is generally deductible as business expense — verify with your CA

variants.name: MSME Term Loan
variants.howItWorks: Amortizing term loan for machinery, shop expansion, or working capital buildup.
variants.bestFor: SMEs with Udyam registration and GST returns.

variants.name: Working Capital / Cash Credit (CC)
variants.howItWorks: Revolving credit limit drawn and repaid against inventory/receivables; interest charged only on drawn amount.
variants.bestFor: Traders and manufacturers with cyclical cash flow.

variants.name: Invoice / Bill Discounting (TReDS)
variants.howItWorks: Advance 70–90% of B2B invoice value upfront; calculates exact discount charge, net proceeds, and annualized cost.
variants.bestFor: MSME suppliers waiting 30–90 days on corporate receivables.

variants.name: PMMY Mudra (Shishu / Kishore / Tarun+)
variants.howItWorks: Collateral-free micro-enterprise loans across Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus tiers configured in Data & Rates.
variants.bestFor: Small shops, service providers, and micro-manufacturers.

categories.name: Credit Card EMI
categories.description: Convert credit card purchases into EMIs with full Indian GST breakdown (configurable 18% GST on BOTH monthly interest & processing fee).
checklistItems: Indian banks levy 18% GST on EVERY monthly interest component of a Credit Card EMI plus 18% GST on processing fee
Even 'No-Cost EMI' still charges 18% GST on the discounted interest component billed by the card issuer
Foreclosing a card EMI typically attracts a 3% fee + 18% GST

variants.name: Standard Credit Card EMI (+ 18% GST)
variants.howItWorks: Reducing-balance EMI where 18% GST (configurable) is added to each month's interest component and to the upfront processing fee.
variants.bestFor: Calculating the true out-of-pocket cost of card EMI conversions.

variants.name: Merchant / No-Cost EMI Audit (+ 18% GST)
variants.howItWorks: Reveals hidden GST on interest and processing fee charged by card issuers even when merchant gives an upfront interest discount.
variants.bestFor: Checking whether No-Cost EMI is truly cheaper than upfront UPI/card payment.
